_readme: DEV DATA, NOT SHIPPED: build.py does not copy this file. One entry per location a player can reach in the Prologue or Act 1. name is the real name (internal, and usable in hints only at severity >= 1 before first_act); safe_name is the spoiler-free label. Bulk items inherit spoiler severity from first_act via severity_rule. confidence: two_or_more_sources | single_act_source | conflict.

_meta.status: REVIEWED by owner on 2026-09-20 (Yellow Harvest and safe names); optional areas cross-checked against 4 more guides
_meta.method: Area order and act from guide walkthrough/zone-order pages; collectible counts from PowerPyx via a page-summarizing fetch tool, so treat counts as unverified. Yellow Harvest resolved provisionally (see entry).
_meta.scope_decision: Merchant-sold items are out of the MVP (decided 2026-09-20).

severity_rule.comment: Naming an area the player has not reached yet is a minor spoiler (S1). Once they have reached its act the location itself is not a spoiler. Item-specific content (a character, a reward, a boss) adds its own severity on top; take the higher value.

locations.name: Lumière
locations.notes: Lumière is visited again in later acts; every item must record which act's visit it belongs to. Harbor scene at the end of the Prologue is the Prologue's point of no return (single source: our seed).

locations.name: Esquie's Nest
locations.notes: Clearing it unlocks a traversal ability that opens the optional areas below.

locations.name: Stone Wave Cliffs
locations.notes: Last main area of Act 1 per all three sources.

locations.name: Yellow Harvest
locations.notes: Resolved 2026-09-20: reachable in Act 1 as soon as Esquie has joined the party. Maxroll's 'post Stone Wave Cliffs' is a recommended order, not an access gate. It is dangerous for an Act 1 party (red danger warning, about level 20 recommended), so every item here carries a note about that.
locations.access: Esquie has joined the party (clear Esquie's Nest)

locations.name: Gestral Beach Near the Gestral Village
sources: Steam community 100% guide (first beach is Act 1)
locations.notes: There are several Gestral Beaches in the game; only this one, near the Gestral Village, is Act 1 (the others are Act 2 and Act 3 per the Steam guide). Only this beach belongs in the MVP.

locations.name: Hidden Gestral Arena
locations.notes: Act 1 per Maxroll (after reaching the village and meeting Esquie) and GameFAQs. Located near Yellow Harvest and the first Gestral Beach. game-checklists lists pictos, outfits and haircuts here without act tags. Game8 has no act information.

locations.name: The Red Woods
locations.notes: Act 1 per GameFAQs; Maxroll lists it after the village. West of The Small Bourgeon.

unresolved.name: Later characters' gear
unresolved.why: Weapons and cosmetics for party members who join later would name them. Use generic wording ('a weapon for a later party member') until their join act is confirmed, and give such hints severity >= 1.

preliminary_counts.note: Counts below come from a summarizing fetch tool reading single pages. They are rough, partly truncated, and mix acts in places. They exist to size the work, not to define it.

pictos_by_area.not_yet_assigned: 24+ under 'The Continent'; some reward pictos come from Nevron quests

outfits_by_area.not_yet_assigned: 26 under 'Lumière (Prologue/Act I)' (includes defaults and edition extras) and 15+ under 'The Continent'

haircuts_by_area.not_yet_assigned: 13 under 'Lumière (Prologue/Act I)' and about 40 under 'The Continent'

preliminary_counts.overall: With merchants out of scope, the named-area items come to roughly 150 to 200 across all categories. That is the working target for the MVP until the extraction pass gives a real number.

excluded_from_mvp.name: Everything sold by merchants (Lumière shops and open-world merchants)
excluded_from_mvp.why: Owner decision 2026-09-20: guides do not record merchant stock by act, so shop items are out of the MVP and the app says so. Revisit with Act 2. Affects roughly 26 outfits and 13 haircuts listed under 'Lumière (Prologue/Act I)', 15+ outfits, 40+ haircuts and 24+ pictos listed under 'The Continent' (counts from game-checklists.com, unverified).

excluded_from_mvp.name: Stone Wave Cliffs Cave
excluded_from_mvp.why: Push Square: Act 2 optional; Maxroll: after Stone Wave Cliffs. game-checklists pictos listed there are out of scope.

excluded_from_mvp.name: Blades' Graveyard
excluded_from_mvp.why: Push Square says Act 2, Steam guide says Act 3. Either way after the MVP.

excluded_from_mvp.name: Other Gestral Beaches
excluded_from_mvp.why: Steam guide: three in Act 2, one in Act 3.
